extracted.intended_audience: readers of The Spectator; general educated public interested in early-18th-century essays and humour
extracted.subtask_description: Close reading of early-18th-century Spectator essays (Addison, Budgell) — short didactic and humorous prose on topics like genius, country wakes, inconstancy, and consolation. The page is a transcription of multiple consecutive Spectator numbers/essays.
